answer: Bind each agent to one ISP-attested broadband line: the ISP signs a certificate tying the identity to a distinct network prefix, renewed monthly, and any duplicate prefix voids both accounts plus their $60 bonds. First, the agent requests the certificate from its ISP; second, the registry checks the prefix against an ocean of live identities; third, peers re-verify the route each epoch and flag any whisper of duplication. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 lines at $40 a month, $400,000 monthly, plus $600,000 in bonds — a price no farm can pay while honest agents rest safe in the harbor.
